name: Storm Sword
description: A broad, blunt-shouldered blade of dark storm-slate with rain-pale streaks alternating down its length instead of one bright cutting edge — weather on the metal rather than a bolt drawn along it. Swept copper wings raked back like a weather vane, a plain grip, and a copper cap for a pommel. Deliberately cold and blue where Thunder is dark iron and gold, and heavy where Wind is slim.
